---
title: "Data sources"
---

Only these sources are used. Each dataset is credited with its owner and the
date it was downloaded, as set out in the [data use policy](data-policy.qmd).

```{python}
from IPython.display import HTML

from shared.sources import SOURCES

rows = "".join(
    f"<tr><td>{s.name}</td>"
    f'<td><a href="{s.licence_url}">{s.licence}</a></td>'
    f'<td><a href="{s.terms_url}">Terms</a></td></tr>'
    for s in SOURCES.values()
)
HTML(
    '<table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Source</th><th>Licence</th><th>Terms</th></tr>'
    f"</thead><tbody>{rows}</tbody></table>"
)
```
